title: Bank Policy 2:
author: Central Bank Authority
pages: Kill Any Nominated Governor on Sight
If the Muknek or Governor Candidates disobeys the law and ignores your nomination. You must kill both of them. This is the only way to protect the bank.
Without the Muknek, the Governor Candidate loses their patron. Kill the Governor Candidate enough times, and the Muknek will lose faith in them.
All resources should be used to kill these individuals. This includes all emerald constructs.
If you fail, the bank dies. Do not let it happen.
